scope: VEC’s Baird Ward postal timetable now records ballot-pack mail-out from 18 January. Its 18 November enrolment reminder confirms the existing 25 November cutoff.

sources.title: Victorian Electoral Commission Baird Ward postal timetable
sources.supports: VEC confirms ballot packs will be mailed from Monday 18 January 2027. The 18 November Victorian Electoral Commission reminder also confirms enrolment closes at 4 pm AEDT on 25 November. The voting cutoff, election day and nomination dates retain their original details.
